description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryModel class, which models employee data for a corporate directory API within the OrangeHRM project. It serializes and normalizes Employee entity data for API responses, including properties like employee number, name, termination info, job title, subunit, and location.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryModel
classes.description: A model class for representing employee data in the corporate directory API. It serializes employee information including personal details, employment terminations, job titles, subunits, and locations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee entity, setting up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
